pr_title: parser: support hints in 'REPLACE INTO' statement (#50007)
pr_body:
This is an automated cherry-pick of #50007

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #34325 

Problem Summary:

Hints are not supported in `REPLACE INTO ...` statement.

### What changed and how does it work?

I simply modify the parser to support this hints. I also tested that some simple hints (e.g. `SET_VAR`) actually work.

issue_context.title: REPLACE statement  with optimizer hint is resulting syntax error
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```sql
drop table if exists t1;
CREATE TABLE t1(a INT, KEY(a));
INSERT /*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2);
REPLACE /*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2);
```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```sql
mysql> INSERT /*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2);
Query OK, 1 row affected, 0 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> REPLACE /*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2);
Query OK, 1 row affected, 0 warning (0.00 sec)
```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```sql
mysql> INSERT /*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2);
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.02 sec)

mysql> REPLACE /*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2);
ERROR 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your TiDB version for the right syntax to use line 1 column 35 near "/*+ SET_VAR(sql_mode='') */ INTO t1 VALUES(2)" 
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

```sql
| Release Version: v6.0.0
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 36a9810441ca0e496cbd22064af274b3be771081
Git Branch: heads/refs/tags/v6.0.0
UTC Build Time: 2022-03-31 10:33:28
GoVersion: go1.18
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false |
```

review_comments:
In the original PR https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/50007, this test is actually in the integration test (see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/50007/files#diff-7b1a286bc1ed3a6acd2b0382122827f63b4fb207134dacd208c4f55898305c9dR1). 

For the cherry-pick in release-7.5, the mysql-tester doesn't have https://github.com/pingcap/mysql-tester/pull/109, so it'll report grammar error (because the mysql-tester is using an older version of parser).

In https://github.com/pingcap/mysql-tester/pull/109, the dependency of TiDB parser is removed, so that integration test on master branch works fine.
